We’re hiring an associate to build and run their own book of investors who back startups directly, and to introduce those investors to the founders we work with.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

You grow the investor side of Pairs. Your book is made of the investors you bring with you and the ones you open here, you keep those relationships warm, and you book the meetings between our founders and the investors who fit them. Family offices and private wealth are the investors we most want more of, so a network that reaches them matters a lot, but VCs are also still a big part of what we do. Pairs has made more than 3,500 investor introductions for founders since we started. You decide which founders an investor in your book hears about, since you are the one who has read the deal and knows the investor. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to investors.
q: Have built your own network of investors who back US startups, ideally with family offices and private wealth in it.
Can show us a count of 100 or more introductions you made between startups and investors.
Have spent at least a year in venture or in another role where you spoke to investors yourself.
Can explain a repeatable method for finding investors who fit and earning a first conversation, and how you stay useful to them afterwards.
Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing.
Build trust by listening first and respecting an investor’s time.
Handle confidential deal and investor information with care.
Use Claude with confidence every day, including connectors and MCP servers.
r: Your book of 70 to 150 investor relationships, each one qualified and kept warm.
First conversations every week with investors who are new to Pairs.
The meetings between our founders and your investors.
Support for our senior team on live deals, which means qualifying investors and writing briefing notes before a meeting and following up after it.
x: OTE of $120,000 to $160,000 USD, base plus commission.

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time. The team works across London, New York, Dubai and San Francisco. You get the best AI tools, paid for, a senior team that coaches you every week, live deal flow from your first week and a path to running your own side of the network.

Apply through our short form. Tell us about the network you built, how you built it and how many introductions between startups and investors you have made. Describe your investors by type and leave their names out.

d: SAON Logistic is a Saudi company specializing in integrated logistics services, offering advanced warehouses with smart management systems and modern technologies. The company focuses on meeting diverse storage needs through innovative solutions that prioritize safety, flexibility, and efficiency in handling products. Goods are stored in an organized way to ensure easy access, accurate management, and strong inventory control. SAON Logistic supports both specialized and general storage environments, providing tailored solutions to protect product integrity and maintain high safety standards. The company is committed to delivering reliable, customer-focused logistics services across the Kingdom.

The Sales Employee (موظف مبيعات) will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, promoting SAON Logistic’s warehousing and logistics services, and building strong relationships with current and potential clients. Daily tasks include conducting client visits, preparing proposals and quotations, following up on leads, negotiating terms, and supporting clients through the sales process.
The role also involves coordinating with operations and customer service teams to ensure that client needs are clearly communicated and met, and maintaining accurate sales records and reports.
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, requiring active engagement with the local market and regular in-person meetings with customers.
Minimum 6 years of professional sales experience is required , preferably in logistics, warehousing, supply chain, or B2B services.
Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and present suitable logistics solutions.
Proven ability to generate leads, acquire new clients, and achieve sales targets.
Customer relationship management skills, including effective communication, follow-up, and client retention.
Good understanding of logistics, warehousing, and supply chain concepts.
Proficiency in using CRM systems, office software, and digital tools for preparing proposals, reports, and client documentation.
Fluency in Arabic; good command of English is an advantage.
Ability to work on-site in Riyadh, manage time effectively, and handle multiple client accounts simultaneously.
Relevant diploma or bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Logistics, or a related discipline is preferred.
